questions.q: How many chromosomes does a human have in total?
questions.why: The script says humans have 46 chromosomes, sorted into 23 pairs.

questions.q: A child receives how many chromosomes from each parent?
questions.why: A child gets 23 from the mother and 23 from the father.

questions.q: Which combination of alleles gives blue eyes?
questions.why: The script says only bb gives blue eyes, while Bb gives brown eyes.
